changes: Added core/receipt-bundle.ts (buildReceiptBundle + verifyReceiptBundleOffline — a local-key-signed, offline, no-server receipt verifier with strict shape check, signature-first ordering, signerPublicKey binding, and receipt exitCode==0 enforcement) + a 18-class adversarial tamper contract-test smoke. Authority cross-host signing deferred.
usage: Run node packages/main/dist/tasks/receipt-bundle-contract-smoke.js — it builds an authentic bundle (ACCEPTED) and runs every tamper class (all REJECTED) with 0 false-accept/false-reject. The contract-test matrix is the paper's C2 (anti-forgery/freshness binding) data proof.
expectedOutcome: Authentic bundle ACCEPTED; every tamper class REJECTED with the correct reason code; 0 false-accept, 0 false-reject; assurance=local-key-single-host (not Authority strong proof).
actualTranscript: build clean; smoke prints authentic ACCEPTED + 18 tamper classes REJECTED (all 10 reason codes reached) + lying-agent + soundness self-checks rejected + 0 false-accept/0 false-reject, exit 0. Independently replayed: exitCode:1/empty-cmd -> receipt_not_passing, hostVerdicts.push(null) -> malformed_bundle, signerPublicKey swap -> signer_key_mismatch, authentic -> ok.
outcomeDiff: No difference. Soundness holes Codex host-2 found in round 1 (incl. a critical) were fixed and re-verified by Codex in round 2.
limitations: Single-host / local-key signing only (honestly labeled, NOT the Authority Tier-C strong proof); Authority cross-host signed verdicts and a user-facing CLI verb are deferred follow-ups. Artifacts in the contract test fit in memory; building a bundle from a real on-disk DONE story + recomputing materialHash from the actual git tree is the CLI-verb follow-up.
pitfalls: Do NOT relabel assurance as Authority/strong-proof. The verifier requires each receipt exitCode===0 + non-empty command + sha256 digest, signerPublicKey===trusted key, and rejects any null/extra field (malformed_bundle) — these defenses (found by Codex host-2) must not be weakened. Verify signature BEFORE trusting signed fields.
